we have demonstrated the first 3.3V, 3D-stacking compatible, 40/65nm BSI SPAD pixel with a pitch of 7,83 μm.

3D integration is a promising approach for SPAD image sensor design, allowing for high performance, high density, and low power imaging.
3D-stacking is a viable technology for SPAD image sensor development, and that the technology is compatible with BSI SPAD image sensors.
